note: Registry vocabularies: key, display name, one-line nature. Transcribed from the ratified definitions in the migrate-species skill (sections 5.1 to 5.7). Games and the Encyclopedia read display names and natures from here; the skill text remains the source.

traits.name: Healing
traits.nature: Restores others; element colors how; flavor never restricts targets.

traits.name: Protective
traits.nature: Instinct to shield and protect others.

traits.name: Regenerative
traits.nature: Rapid self-repair, organic or mechanical.

traits.name: Armored
traits.nature: Natural plating, shell, or integrated chassis.

traits.name: Anchored
traits.nature: Cannot be moved against its will.

traits.name: Phasing
traits.nature: Some physical interactions pass through it; auto-granted to non-corporeal bodies, rare roll on corporeal ones.

traits.name: Resistant
traits.nature: Shrugs off contamination: toxins, disease, radiation, corrosion, hostile atmospheres (bodily only).

traits.name: Ramming
traits.nature: A living ram; blows land far harder with movement behind them.

traits.name: Toxic
traits.nature: Natural weapons deliver debilitating agents; element colors which.

traits.name: Volatile
traits.nature: Hazardous to strike; reacts when hit, element-colored.

traits.name: Reflective
traits.nature: Energy directed at it returns to its source.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.nature: Its presence erodes courage.

traits.name: Hypnotic
traits.nature: Entrances and holds attention, dulling the will to act (caps there).

traits.name: Perceptive
traits.nature: Perceives what hides; the counter to stealthy.

traits.name: Foresighted
traits.nature: Reads moments before they happen.

traits.name: Mind Sealed
traits.nature: Nothing enters, sways, or breaks its mind; counters hypnotic and menacing.

traits.name: Pack Bonded
traits.nature: Stronger coordinating with others (excludes solitary).

traits.name: Solitary
traits.nature: Stronger operating alone (excludes pack-bonded).

traits.name: Stealthy
traits.nature: Moves unseen and unheard until it acts.

traits.name: Nocturnal
traits.nature: Night-adapted senses and habits.

traits.name: Inspiring
traits.nature: Its presence bolsters allies.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.nature: Cannot be held: escapes grabs, pins, traps, snares.

traits.name: Luminous
traits.nature: Its body sheds light; strips darkness and shadow concealment nearby.

traits.name: Telekinetic
traits.nature: Moves things without touching them; levitation is constant, flinging is the derived ability.

elements.name: Electric
elements.nature: Storm and surge, chain and link.

corporeality.name: Corporeal
corporeality.nature: Has a physical body that occupies space and can be touched, struck, and held.

corporeality.name: Non Corporeal
corporeality.nature: Has no persistent physical body; matter passes through it and it through matter.

composition.name: Flesh
composition.nature: Living animal tissue, muscle and organ, whatever covers it.

composition.name: Plant
composition.nature: Living vegetable tissue: wood, fiber, stem, leaf, root.

composition.name: Mineral
composition.nature: Stone, crystal, sand, or glass held together as a body.

composition.name: Metal
composition.nature: Metallic body, whether grown, forged, or assembled.

composition.name: Slime
composition.nature: Viscous or gelatinous mass with no fixed internal structure.

composition.name: Gas
composition.nature: A body of vapor, smoke, or cloud that holds a shape at rest.

composition.name: Energy
composition.nature: A body of light, plasma, charge, or heat with no matter to speak of.

composition.name: Spectral
composition.nature: A body of the ghost register: present, visible, and acting, but made of neither matter nor energy that instruments can name.

bodyPlan.name: Biped
bodyPlan.nature: Stands and moves on two legs; forelimbs, if any, are free for other work.

bodyPlan.name: Quadruped
bodyPlan.nature: Stands and moves on four limbs.

bodyPlan.name: Multiped
bodyPlan.nature: Stands and moves on more than four limbs, or on a limb arrangement that no other key names.

bodyPlan.name: Serpentine
bodyPlan.nature: A long body that moves by undulation, with no limbs or with limbs too small to bear it.

bodyPlan.name: Avian
bodyPlan.nature: A winged body whose primary movement is flight and which lands or perches between flights.

bodyPlan.name: Piscine
bodyPlan.nature: A body built for movement through liquid: finned, streamlined, or jet-driven.

bodyPlan.name: Amorphous
bodyPlan.nature: A body without a fixed outline that flows, spreads, or reforms as it moves.

bodyPlan.name: Swarm
bodyPlan.nature: The creature presents as many bodies acting as one, whether the units are its own flesh, split-off pieces, or conjured projections held by a central mind.

bodyPlan.name: Floating
bodyPlan.nature: A body that hangs, drifts, or glides in its medium with no wings and no fins, held up by gas, field, or the ghost register.

covering.name: Scales
covering.nature: Overlapping plates of skin or horn, reptile or fish style, flexible as a whole.

covering.name: Chitin
covering.nature: A hard exoskeleton or carapace grown by the body.

covering.name: Hide
covering.nature: Thick, leathery, or rugged skin with no armored aspect.

covering.name: Plating
covering.nature: Rigid plates that are not grown chitin: stone, metal, bone, or crystal armor integrated into the body.

covering.name: Crystal
covering.nature: A surface of crystal growth or facets covering the body.

covering.name: Mist
covering.nature: A surface of vapor, smoke, or haze with no firm boundary.

covering.name: Bare
covering.nature: Smooth unprotected skin, membrane, or surface; the default for any body, of any composition, whose surface neither source names.

diet.name: Energy Feeder
diet.nature: Feeds on a non-food energy the description names it taking in: heat, charge, radiation, gravity, minds.

diet.name: None
diet.nature: Does not feed at all, stated or implied by a body with no way to take anything in.

communication.name: Vocal
communication.nature: Calls, cries, roars, songs, hisses; any sound the body makes to signal.

communication.name: Vibration
communication.nature: Signals by tremor, drumming, or percussion through ground, water, or air.

communication.name: Display
communication.nature: Signals to others by posture, color, light pattern, or gesture.

communication.name: Chemical
communication.nature: Signals by scent or secreted substance.

communication.name: Telepathic
communication.nature: Signals by direct impression on another mind; feeling and image, never words.

media.name: Liquid
media.nature: Water or another liquid of any chemistry.

lifespan.name: Fleeting
lifespan.nature: A season to a few years.

lifespan.name: Short
lifespan.nature: A few years to a decade.

lifespan.name: Long
lifespan.nature: Many decades to a century or more.

chirality.name: Rolled
chirality.nature: Each individual rolls levo or dextro at 50/50; the default.

chirality.name: Achiral
chirality.nature: The species has no handedness to roll; declared only when the body has no chiral chemistry.

descriptionStatus.name: Source
descriptionStatus.nature: The species.json description is carried verbatim because it is already in the full register.

descriptionStatus.name: Upgraded
descriptionStatus.nature: The description was rewritten from a stub using only the stub, the art, and the planet history.

capabilities.name: Flight
capabilities.nature: Sustained movement through air under its own power.

capabilities.name: Burrow
capabilities.nature: Movement through solid ground, sand, or rubble.

capabilities.name: Climb
capabilities.nature: Movement up surfaces steeper than it can walk.

capabilities.name: Leap
capabilities.nature: Distance or height cleared in one bound.

capabilities.name: Manipulation
capabilities.nature: Handling objects; an upper bound above 40 needs grasping anatomy or telekinetic at 100.

senses.name: Sight
senses.nature: Graded vision; how well the creature sees.

senses.name: Hearing
senses.nature: Graded hearing; how well the creature hears.

senses.name: Smell
senses.nature: Graded smell; how well the creature scents.

senses.name: Echolocation
senses.nature: Locates by emitted sound and its return.

senses.name: Tremorsense
senses.nature: Reads vibration through ground or water to locate what moves.

senses.name: Electroreception
senses.nature: Senses electric fields and living charge.

senses.name: Psychic
senses.nature: Senses minds, feelings, and intent directly.

senses.name: Void Sense
senses.nature: Senses gravity, mass, and the structure of space; the dark register's sense.

anatomy.name: Pincers
anatomy.nature: Opposing grip; a crab's, scorpion's, or lobster's claws that snap shut are pincers, never claws, whatever word the description uses.

anatomy.name: Blades
anatomy.nature: Limb ending in a cutting edge.

anatomy.name: Wings
anatomy.nature: Strike, gust, shroud as well as flight.

anatomy.name: Hide
anatomy.nature: An unarmored body surface used defensively: bare, leathery, furred, or scaled skin; declaring hide states that the body has no armored aspect.

anatomy.name: Shell
anatomy.nature: The armored aspect: a rigid enclosing casing, exoskeleton, carapace, or integrated plating.

anatomy.name: Spines
anatomy.nature: Rigid projections: quills, barbs, thorns, crystal growths.

anatomy.name: Pseudopods
anatomy.nature: Temporary limbs coalesced from a formless body.

anatomy.name: Core
anatomy.nature: Exposed radiant or crystal focal mass.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.nature: Whole-body mass as instrument; universal fallback.

channels.name: Mind
channels.nature: Psychic element, a psychic special sense, or telekinetic/hypnotic at 100 in the trait pool.

channels.name: Gaze
channels.nature: Sight band above 0, plus the description supports a stare.

channels.name: Swarm
channels.nature: BodyPlan: swarm, or the description and art show a conjured familiar swarm held by the creature's mind.

channels.name: Aura
channels.nature: The description describes an emanation from the body as a whole that acts on everything around it, such as a presence, a field, a chill, or a glow.

actions.name: Strike
actions.nature: A single direct blow or thrust that lands with impact.

actions.name: Lash
actions.nature: A sweeping or whipping blow from a flexible part or a swept limb.

actions.name: Crush
actions.nature: Pressure applied and held: squeezing, clamping, compressing.

actions.name: Rake
actions.nature: A cutting or tearing pass that opens the target.

actions.name: Shove
actions.nature: Force that moves the target rather than wounds it: pushes, rams, throws off balance.

actions.name: Drain
actions.nature: Takes something from the target and keeps it: vitality, heat, charge, will.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.nature: A burst of closing speed that ends in a hit.

actions.name: Beam
actions.nature: A focused projected line of energy or matter.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.nature: A thrown or launched solid that travels to the target.

actions.name: Spray
actions.nature: A projected stream or shower of matter over an area or line.

actions.name: Burst
actions.nature: An outward release from the body that hits everything close at once.

actions.name: Cloud
actions.nature: A lingering volume of matter or effect that occupies space.

actions.name: Snare
actions.nature: Holds, binds, pulls, or pins the target in place.

actions.name: Ward
actions.nature: Protects the user or an ally: shields, deflects, braces.

actions.name: Mend
actions.nature: Restores the user or an ally.

actions.name: Terrorize
actions.nature: Acts on the target's courage or will rather than its body.
